title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-prep-2026-06-01
content:
Weekly sync (serving-runtime / infra / console) - prep notes and running action items

Date: 2026-06-01 (weekly)
Time: 10:00-10:45 PT
Owner / facilitator: Ava Chen
Location: Zoom / #eng-serving-runtime
Goal: surface infra risks, rollout status for console changes, unblock any serving-runtime regressions, and track action items.

Attendees (expected):
- Ava Chen (hosting / infra coordinator)
- Devon Park (runtime perf)
- Mateo Rivera (console / rollout)
- Priya Singh (SRE / alerts)
- Noah Brooks (release eng)
- Optional: ops on-call

Agenda (timeboxed)
1) Quick rundowns (10 min) - 1-2 bullets each
   - Runtime: recent perf spikes on model x-neo; metric summary and hypothesis (Devon)
   - Infra: node drain test results, disk pressure alert flapping (Priya)
   - Console: canary rollout 2026-05-29 feedback + hotfix status (Mateo)

2) Priority blockers & incident follow-ups (10 min)
   - KV cache eviction regression from 2026-05-27 (SERV-1024) - root cause and mitigation
   - Disk pressure: temp autoscale adjustment vs long-term sizing

3) Rollout / rollout policy decisions (8 min)
   - Canary results for console feature flags: decide full roll / extend canary
   - Traffic routing fallback policy for low-memory hosts

4) Operational items & upcoming maintenance (7 min)
   - Plan for kernel upgrades on staging (Noah)
   - PVC migration window: impact to dedicated customers?

5) Action items review & owners (5 min)
   - Quick check on items from last week and assign new ones

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep the KV cache regression discussion concise: need clear ask (rollback vs patch).
- Bring sample traces (latency tail) and a short graph - 95/99th pct. Devon to paste link in thread before meeting.
- Confirm on-call availability for disk-pressure window. If absent, escalate to SRE lead.

Running action items (live tracking)
- [AI-2026-01] Devon: narrow down commit that introduced KV cache eviction pattern; post repro steps and candidate fix by 2026-06-04. status: in_progress. linked: SERV-1024
- [AI-2026-02] Priya: create temporary autoscale rule to suppress noisy disk-pressure alerts during spike; target deploy by 2026-06-02. status: in_progress. linked: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-932
- [AI-2026-03] Mateo: finish console canary dashboard (add per-route latency and error budget) and share link prior to rollout decision. due: 2026-06-03. status: blocked (waiting on perf traces)
- [AI-2026-04] Noah: schedule kernel upgrade on staging, validate model-serving smoke tests. due: 2026-06-08. status: todo
- [AI-2026-05] Ava: prepare brief decision doc for canary/full-roll options and cost implications. due: 2026-06-02. status: in_progress

Open questions / parking lot
- If KV cache fix needs rollback, what's the exact rollback window and customer impact (SLA implications)? Need input from product.
- Dedicated customers: do we need to notify about potential PVC migration disruption? Legal / CS review required.

Prep checklist (what I need before the meeting)
- Devon posts 95/99 latency graphs + sample traces into the meeting thread (channel: #eng-serving-runtime).
- Mateo posts canary metrics dashboard link and notes.
- Priya confirms autoscale temp rule YAML + alert suppression plan.
- I (Ava) will draft the short decision doc and attach it to the Confluence page.

Post-meeting follow-up template (use after meeting to update running items)
- Summary: one-line summary of outcome / decision
- New action items: enumerate with owner + due date + linked artifact (PR/Jira/Linear)
- Blockers: escalate list with suggested next step
- Attach: meeting notes + relevant links to Confluence / PRs

Quick links
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SR/serving-runtime-weekly
- KV cache issue: SERV-1024
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/812
- Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-932

Scratch / drafts (stuff to copy into meeting notes)
- Intro: "Quick state: runtime stable for p50/p90; p99 elevated last 36h due to cache eviction churn; infra saw increased disk pressure during night window; console canary is healthy but 2 routes show elevated 4xxs."
- Decision ask (canary): "If no new regressions and per-route 99th latency < 1.2x baseline for 24h, proceed to 100% roll. Otherwise, pause and run targeted repro. Cost note: roll increases burst to dedicated GPUs - approx +6% unit cost (estimate)."

Notes to file after meeting:
- Move completed action items to final and add links to PRs/Jira in the action item line.
- Update Confluence page with summary and date stamp.

----
Internal/rough: keep this document messy. Will finalize and copy to shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime after the meeting if notes are clean.
